journal: Journal of the American Chemical Society 65, 221-224
title: Isopiestic Measurements in Dilute Solutions; the System Potassium Chloride-Sodium Chloride at 25 deg at Concentrations from 0.03 to 0.10 Molal
experimental_method: Isopiestic method in a new apparatus (silver dishes in a glass vessel, rocked in a Dewar-insulated thermostat controlled to 0.003 K; careful removal of air by repeated pumping, 7 to 18 days equilibration); KCl and NaCl solutions made gravimetrically from twice recrystallized salts, final concentrations by weighing.
uncertainties_stated: error in the isopiestic ratio from weighing losses not more than 0.03 percent; thermostat 0.003 deg.
quality_remarks: Author states that the performance of the apparatus was disappointing; the 4 starred rows (Q = 0.9951, 1.0059, 1.0037, 1.0036) deviate markedly from unity and are attributed to unattained equilibrium (inadequately out-gassed solutions). Osmotic coefficients are interpolated from literature e.m.f.-based tables, not computed from these runs. The PDF pages 1-3 are this paper (journal pp. 221-223); page 4 starts with a different article (Olynyk and Gordon, vapour pressure of NaCl 2 m to saturation at 20, 25, 30 C, p. 224) whose table is not part of this DOI and was not extracted. PDF page 1 begins with the end of a preceding article (Added Nov. 16, 1942 note and Summary).
not_extracted_tables: Olynyk and Gordon NaCl vapour pressure table on PDF page 4 belongs to another article (a separate DOI), and only its start is in this PDF
